_: THE TEN YEARS, ONE AT A TIME — what the College must achieve in each
year, what it does to achieve it, the decision the Board takes at the
end of it, and the condition that closes the year.
The text here is the plan's design. Every number the roadmap prints —
people, learners, spend, cash, the capital drawn — is read from the
model for that year (scripts/plan/roadmap.mjs), never typed here.

2027.objective: Constitute the institution and teach its first intake to the standard it will keep.
actions: Incorporate, constitute the Board of Governors and adopt the academic and governance instruments
Appoint the Principal, the Director of Academic Standards, the Registrar and the Head of Finance
Author Levels I to III and their examinations across the two terms before launch, and Level IV in the launch term; build and independently test the platform
Appoint the External Examiners before the first examination is set
Open admissions in the Gulf and teach the first intake in the Autumn term
2027.gate: Launch: the Board releases the Launch tranche only when Levels I to III are authored and reviewed, the platform has passed its security test, and the academic offices and first instructors are in post
2027.exit: The first intake has sat its Level examination, every script has been second-marked, and the first moderation has been reported to the Board

2028.objective: Teach every level of the qualification for the first time, and open the second market.
actions: Author Levels V and VI, each in the term before it is first taught
Open admissions in the United Kingdom and Europe
Receive the External Examiners' first annual report and answer it in writing
Confer the first awards at the sixth level in the Autumn term
Open the employer channel in the Autumn term
Commission the first independent audit of the College's accounts
2028.gate: First-year review: the Board reviews continuation, the External Examiners' report and the measured cost of an enrolment against the plan, and confirms the acquisition budget for the year ahead
2028.exit: All six levels taught, examined and moderated at least once; the first audit signed

2029.objective: Prove the academic and commercial model on measured results before the College draws the capital to expand.
actions: Confer the six-level qualification on the first learners who entered at Level I
Measure continuation, completion and the cost of an enrolment in each market over two full years
Sign the first employer agreements and report their completion separately
Prepare the West Africa and Asia launches and the institutional channel
2029.gate: Validation: the Board releases the third tranche only on a full year of teaching, assessment, moderation and conferral reviewed by the External Examiners, continuation within five points of plan, and a measured cost of an enrolment within a quarter of plan
2029.exit: The third tranche released or withheld on the evidence, and the acquisition budget reset to measured cost

2030.objective: Open the College's last two markets and its institutional channel.
actions: Open retail admissions in Asia and sign the first institutional agreements, in West Africa, Asia and the Gulf
Apply to the British Accreditation Council for accreditation of the College's online provision and host its inspection
Run the first annual quality review across all four markets
2030.gate: Reach: the Board confirms that each new market's first two intakes convert within a quarter of plan before its acquisition budget steps up
2030.exit: Four markets and both agreement channels open; the inspection completed

2031.objective: Pass the lowest point of the College's cash and earn its first surplus.
actions: Hold hiring to the establishment the work requires, term by term
Complete the accreditation body's interim inspection
Renew or replace the External Examiners at the end of their four-year terms
Begin hedging sterling costs a year ahead
2031.gate: The turn: the Board confirms the trough has passed and that the remaining capital is not needed to reach the first surplus
2031.exit: A full year in which fees exceed the whole cost of the institution

2032.objective: Bring every market to the acquisition budget its payback allows, and no further.
actions: Take each market's acquisition budget to its final planned level
Review every route's section sizes and advising hours against measured learner results
Report learner results by route and by market to the Board, to test that every route delivers what it promises
2032.gate: Scale: the Board confirms no market is funded past the level at which its last dollar pays back within a learner's first level
2032.exit: Every market at its planned budget, each inside its payback ceiling

2033.objective: Run the institution at full scale on its own income.
actions: Review the curriculum of every level against five years of results, within the maintenance hours the establishment already carries
Extend institutional agreements into second terms with the first buyers
2033.gate: Consolidation: the Board confirms the College has met its costs from its own income for three consecutive years
2033.exit: The establishment stable at the size its work requires

2034.objective: Operate at the volume the tariff was built on, and renew accreditation.
actions: Measure the year's cost of each route against the price build-up on which the tariff was set
Complete the four-yearly re-inspection for accreditation
Publish the College's first five-year report on learner results
2034.gate: Maturity: the Board compares the year's actual cost of each route with the price build-up and resets the tariff if they differ
2034.exit: The tariff confirmed or reset on measured cost

2035.objective: Hold enough cash to return the founding capital in full.
actions: Agree with the founders the form and timing of the return of capital
Build the reserve towards its target
2035.gate: Return: the Board decides the return of capital, having confirmed the reserve is not drawn below its target to make it
2035.exit: The College's cash at or above the founding capital

2036.objective: End the decade with the founding capital returnable and six months of cost held in reserve.
actions: Complete the reserve
Present the Board with the second ten-year plan, built from the first decade's measured results
2036.gate: The plan's test: capital returnable and the reserve at target
